info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Rules-v4-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Rules Retrieval API enables businesses to access and review their loyalty program rules. By leveraging this API, consumers can fetch detailed information about various loyalty rules defined within their program, helping them to understand eligibility criteria, reward structures, and other essential parameters. This endpoint is vital for applications managing customer engagement strategies and analyzing loyalty performance. Typical users include marketing teams, program managers, and developers building loyalty-related features.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current loyalty rules applicable in the system. It provides detailed information about how customers can earn and redeem points through our loyalty program.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to retrieve loyalty rules. It should include all relevant filters and criteria based on the API's specifications.
